claims.text: The target as-cast eutectic HEA has a lamellar or rod-like microstructure containing a soft FCC phase and a hard BCC phase or intermetallic compound.
Combining a soft FCC phase with a hard BCC phase or intermetallic compound can provide a balance between strength and ductility in EHEAs.
Cryo-rolling followed by brief annealing will refine the eutectic lamellar microstructure.
Cryo-rolling followed by annealing will increase deformation-twin density in the FCC phase.
Cryo-rolling followed by annealing will increase dislocation density in the FCC phase.
Refining the lamellar spacing will increase the interface density between the soft and hard phases.
Cryo-rolling introduces high dislocation density and twinning in the ductile FCC phase.
A brief low-temperature anneal relieves localized internal stresses.
The proposed annealing treatment can relieve stresses without significantly coarsening the microstructure.
Refined interfaces and the hard phase contribute to increased strength.
Retained deformation mechanisms in the FCC phase provide improved ductility after processing.
Cryo-rolling and annealing will increase both yield strength and ultimate tensile strength relative to the as-cast state.
Cryo-rolling and annealing will maintain or moderately increase tensile elongation relative to the as-cast state.
The processed material will exhibit improved work-hardening behavior.
The intervention should be effective for EHEAs with dual-phase lamellar microstructures similar to AlCoCrFeNi2.1.
The intervention may not apply to single-phase HEAs or alloys with markedly different microstructures.
The strength-ductility balance produced by the treatment can vary with alloy composition and processing conditions.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis calls the intervention a single thermomechanical processing step, but it consists of two sequential operations: cryo-rolling and annealing.
The main hypothesis and falsification rule require increased ductility relative to the as-cast state, whereas the predicted outcome also permits merely maintained elongation.
